_comment: Native Burst Selection (emtk). Binds to BurstSelectionModel (gui/model.py). The parameters of the selected burst search are not here: they are generated from the JSON Schema tttrlib publishes (model.search_sections), so a new search needs no change. The app picks sections by title.

sections.title: Files
sections.description: The raw TTTR files of the search.
The TTTR files searched by Run, in order. Click a row to show that file in the plots and the bursts table; Delete removes it. Drop files or folders on the window to add them.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The file name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Bursts
columns.tooltip: Bursts found in this file by the last Run (empty before a run).

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the file is in.

sections.title: Output
sections.description: Where a run writes the bursts.
Where the results go is decided by the input: a .pto keeps its bursts inside itself; a vendor file gets the bi4_bur/ companion folder beside it.

sections.label: Zip output
sections.description: Zip the companion folder after the run (vendor files only; a .pto has no folder).

sections.label: Remove folder
sections.description: Delete the unzipped companion folder once it is zipped.

sections.label: MMFDB
sections.description: Also register the raw files and the burst selection in the MMFDB, linked to a sample.

sections.label: Sample
sections.description: The MMFDB sample the raw files belong to. From the raw files: use the sample they are already registered with.

sections.title: Burst search
sections.description: Which burst search runs; its parameters follow.

sections.label: Search
sections.description: The burst search, from tttrlib's registry. Changing it starts the parameters from that search's defaults.
What the selected search does (from the registry).

sections.title: Channel selection
sections.description: Which photons the search sees.

sections.label: Detector
sections.description: Search only the routing channels of this detector. All: every photon.
The routing channels the filter keeps.

sections.label: Micro-time window
sections.description: Search only photons inside this PIE window. All: the full decay.
The micro-time ranges the filter keeps.

sections.title: Macro time interval
sections.description: Cuts on the time between consecutive photons, applied before the search.

sections.label: Use min dT
sections.description: Drop photons that follow the previous one sooner than the minimum.

sections.label: Min dT
sections.description: Minimum inter-photon time in milliseconds (active when Use min dT is on).

sections.label: Use max dT
sections.description: Keep only photons that follow the previous one within the maximum: the burst photons.

sections.label: Max dT
sections.description: Maximum inter-photon time in milliseconds (active when Use max dT is on). It also names the output folder.

sections.label: Fill gaps
sections.description: Merge selections separated by a few unselected photons.

sections.label: Merge gap
sections.description: Largest run of unselected photons that is filled (when Fill gaps is on).

sections.title: Filter
sections.description: The photon filter switches and the burst-level size cut.

sections.label: Filter on
sections.description: Apply the photon filter. Off: every photon goes to the search.

sections.label: Invert
sections.description: Invert the filter selection.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: A burst with fewer photons is dropped after the search (every search). It names the output folder.

sections.label: Count-rate photons
sections.description: Photons used to compute a count rate (recorded with the run).

sections.title: Display
sections.description: What the diagnostic plots draw.

sections.label: All photons
sections.description: Draw the layers computed from every photon in the visible window.

sections.label: Selected photons
sections.description: Draw the layers computed from the photons the search kept.

sections.label: Window start
sections.description: Start of the visible window in the active file. The plots and the preview are computed for this slice only.

sections.label: Window length
sections.description: Length of the visible window; 0 shows the whole file.

sections.label: MCS bin width
sections.description: Bin width of the count-rate trace.

sections.label: Decay coarsening
sections.description: Micro-time channels summed per decay bin.

sections.label: Burst bins
sections.description: Bins of the burst-duration histogram.

sections.title: Histogram
sections.description: The 1D histogram of one burst feature.

sections.label: Feature
sections.description: The burst-table column histogrammed (the proximity ratio is computed from the green and red photons).

sections.label: Bins
sections.description: Number of histogram bins.

sections.label: Range from
sections.description: Lower histogram bound (a range with from >= to uses the data range).

sections.label: Range to
sections.description: Upper histogram bound.

sections.label: Log counts
sections.description: Logarithmic count axis.

sections.label: GMM components
sections.description: Gaussians fitted by Fit GMM (0 with Auto components: chosen by BIC).

sections.label: Auto components
sections.description: With 0 components, choose the number by the Bayesian information criterion.

sections.title: GMM
sections.description: Weight, mean and standard deviation of each fitted Gaussian.

sections.title: Scatter
sections.description: Two burst features against each other.

sections.label: X
sections.description: Feature on the horizontal axis.

sections.label: Y
sections.description: Feature on the vertical axis.

sections.title: Bursts
sections.description: The bursts of the active file (or of the visible window before a run), without the zero separator rows. Click a header to sort.

sections.title: Summary
sections.description: Key figures of the last run.

sections.title: GMM settings
sections.description: Advanced Gaussian-mixture settings (drawn over model.gmm).

sections.label: Covariance type
sections.description: Covariance model of the mixture.

sections.label: Random state
sections.description: Seed of the initialisation (fixed for reproducible fits).

sections.label: Max iterations
sections.description: Expectation-maximisation iterations per start.

sections.label: Starts
sections.description: Random starts; the best is kept.

sections.label: Tolerance
sections.description: Convergence threshold of the log-likelihood gain.

sections.label: Max components
sections.description: Largest number of components tried by Auto components.

sections.label: Covariance regularisation
sections.description: Added to the covariance diagonal for stability.

sections.title: Metadata
sections.description: Analysis metadata written with the flrCIF export.

sections.label: Key
sections.description: A metadata key (the common ones first, then the PDBx keys).

sections.label: Value
sections.description: Its value.

buttons.label: Add entry
buttons.description: Add or replace the entry for this key.

sections.description: The metadata entries. Select a row and press Delete to remove it.
